1. Gather 1 dark oak log.
2. Craft 4 dark oak planks using the dark oak log.
3. Gather 1 birch log.
4. Craft 4 birch planks using the birch log.
5. Gather 1 spruce log.
6. Craft 4 spruce planks using the spruce log.
7. Gather 1 oak log.
8. Craft 4 oak planks using the oak log.

13. Gather 2 sticks.
14. Craft 4 stick using the 2 sticks.
15. Gather 1 stone slab.
